      2026 - 2027 Tuition & Fees

      The CUSM Board of Trustees reviews tuition and fees at least once annually. CUSM-SOM will make every effort to keep student costs to a minimum. All listed fees should be regarded as estimates that are subject to change.

      MD Program

        Fall Spring Fall/Spring
      Tuition1 36,050.00 36,050.00 72,100.00
      Registration Fee2 100.00 100.00 200.00
      MD General Fee3 2,250.00 2,250.00 4,500.00
      Health Insurance5 5,771.00 0.00 5,771.00
      Total 44,171.00 38,400.00 82,571.00

       

      MBS Program

        Fall Spring Fall/Spring
      Tuition1 21,650.00 21,650.00 43,300.00
      Registration Fee2 100.00 100.00 200.00
      MBS General Fee4 1,300.00 1,300.00 2,600.00
      Health Insurance5 5,771.00 0.00 5,771.00
      Total 28,821.00 23,050.00 51,871.00

       

      Other Fees: 

      Returned Check Fees A $25 fee is assessed for any check returned for non-payment including any check in which payment is stopped.  
      Late Payment of Tuition and Fees A late payment fee of $200 is assessed to students who do not pay by the tuition due date. Students who do not pay by the due date will be withdrawn from CUSM.   

       

      1 Tuition - In and Out of State. Note that these fees may be refundable if a student withdraws within the first seven (7) days of the semester of enrollment. Please refer to CUSM Tuition Refund Policy on our webpage:

      Tuition Refund Policy 

      2 Registration Fee - Per the AMCAS Application and Acceptance Protocols, the initial registration deposit of $100 before matriculation is refundable until April 30 of the application cycle the applicant applied. After April 30th the registration fee is non-refundable fee. 

      3 MD General Fee - Non-Refundable. Equipment, Lab, Textbooks/Other learning media, Student association, Orientation, Disability insurance premium, Laptop, or tablet.  

      4 MBS General Fee - Non-Refundable. Textbooks/Other learning media, Student association, Orientation, Disability insurance premium, Laptop or Tablet. 

      5 Health Insurance Charge & Waiver Option - All CUSM students will automatically be charged for Student Health Insurance. This charge will appear on your Fall 2026 tuition bill.  If you wish to waive or remove the Student Health Insurance charge from your billing statement, you must follow the instructions provided by the Registrar/Student Records office. It's important to remember that students who do not waive or opt-out by the specified deadline will be responsible for the health insurance cost.

      Other Fees:

      Late Payment of Tuition and Fees A late payment fee of $200 is assessed to students who do not pay by the tuition due date. Students who do not pay by the due date will be withdrawn from CUSM.   

       

      1 Tuition - In and Out of State. Note that these fees may be refundable if a student withdraws within the first seven (7) days of the semester of enrollment. Please refer to CUSM Tuition Refund Policy on our webpage: Tuition Refund Policy 

      2 Registration Fee - Per the AMCAS Application and Acceptance Protocols, the initial registration deposit of $100 before matriculation is refundable until April 30 of the application cycle the applicant applied. After April 30th the registration fee is non-refundable fee. 

      3 MD General Fee - Non-Refundable. Equipment, Lab, Textbooks/Other learning media, Student association, Orientation, Disability insurance premium, Laptop, or tablet.  

      4 MBS General Fee - Non-Refundable. Textbooks/Other learning media, Student association, Orientation, Disability insurance premium, Laptop or Tablet. 

      5 25/26 Health Insurance Charge & Waiver Option - All CUSM students will automatically be charged $5,482.00 for Student Health Insurance. This charge will appear on your Fall 2025 tuition bill.  If you wish to waive or remove the Student Health Insurance charge from your billing statement, you must follow the instructions provided by the Registrar/Student Records office. Waiver Submission are due by: Thursday, July 31, 2025 - No Exceptions. It's important to remember that students who do not waive or opt-out by the specified deadline will be responsible for the health insurance cost. To begin the waiver process and provide proof of comparable health insurance go to: https://students.care26.com/login

      Please note: Students who have not submitted a waiver by the end of business on Thursday, July 31, 2025,  will automatically be enrolled into the school’s health insurance plan. If you should have any questions, concerns, or need guidance, please do not hesitate to contact:
